# coolify_notification_email (Data Source)

Reads the current team's email notification settings (SMTP, Resend, and/or instance settings). This is a team-scoped singleton (selected by the API token). Requires Coolify >= v4.3.0.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coolify_notification_email" "current" {}

output "notifications" {
  value = data.coolify_notification_email.current.smtp_enabled
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `backup_failure` (Boolean) Whether email notifications are sent for backup failure events.
- `backup_success` (Boolean) Whether email notifications are sent for backup success events.
- `deployment_failure` (Boolean) Whether email notifications are sent for deployment failure events.
- `deployment_success` (Boolean) Whether email notifications are sent for deployment success events.
- `docker_cleanup_failure` (Boolean) Whether email notifications are sent for Docker cleanup failure events.
- `docker_cleanup_success` (Boolean) Whether email notifications are sent for Docker cleanup success events.
- `id` (String) Identifier. Always `current` (team is implied by the API token).
- `resend_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Resend API key. Coolify may omit this unless the API token can read sensitive fields (`read:sensitive` or root).
- `resend_enabled` (Boolean) Whether Resend delivery is enabled.
- `scheduled_task_failure` (Boolean) Whether email notifications are sent for scheduled task failure events.
- `scheduled_task_success` (Boolean) Whether email notifications are sent for scheduled task success events.
- `server_disk_usage` (Boolean) Whether email notifications are sent for server disk usage events.
- `server_patch` (Boolean) Whether email notifications are sent for server patch events.
- `server_reachable` (Boolean) Whether email notifications are sent for server reachable events.
- `server_unreachable` (Boolean) Whether email notifications are sent for server unreachable events.
- `smtp_ehlo_domain` (String) Hostname sent with SMTP EHLO. Requires Coolify >= v4.3.10.
- `smtp_enabled` (Boolean) Whether SMTP delivery is enabled.
- `smtp_encryption` (String) SMTP encryption (`starttls`, `tls`, or `none`).
- `smtp_from_address` (String, Sensitive) SMTP From address. Coolify may omit this unless the API token can read sensitive fields (`read:sensitive` or root).
- `smtp_from_name` (String, Sensitive) SMTP From display name. Coolify may omit this unless the API token can read sensitive fields (`read:sensitive` or root).
- `smtp_host` (String, Sensitive) SMTP host. Coolify may omit this unless the API token can read sensitive fields (`read:sensitive` or root).
- `smtp_password` (String, Sensitive) SMTP password. Coolify may omit this unless the API token can read sensitive fields (`read:sensitive` or root).
- `smtp_port` (Number) SMTP port.
- `smtp_recipients` (String, Sensitive) Comma-separated recipient addresses. Coolify may omit this unless the API token can read sensitive fields (`read:sensitive` or root).
- `smtp_timeout` (Number) SMTP timeout in seconds.
- `smtp_username` (String, Sensitive) SMTP username. Coolify may omit this unless the API token can read sensitive fields (`read:sensitive` or root).
- `status_change` (Boolean) Whether email notifications are sent for status change events.
- `traefik_outdated` (Boolean) Whether email notifications are sent for Traefik outdated events.
- `use_instance_email_settings` (Boolean) Whether the team uses the Coolify instance email settings.
